FOUNDER DIRECTIVE (Samuel, 2026-09-08), relayed verbatim by Fable to A, copied to B and Fable. Fable adds no authorization of its own.

EXECUTE THE NEXT STAGE NOW. CONTINUE THE EXISTING XENIOS HEALTH GOAL.

Staging tetynodzrtmdbuzgboro has just been independently observed
as ACTIVE_HEALTHY. Do not repeat restoration or reset the project.

A:
Check whether your managed run is already active. Preserve it;
do not start a duplicate.

Otherwise, verify staging-bound credentials, approved synthetic
roles, the benign private PDF and the permitted effects, then
run the existing managed qualification harness.

Use 8be5d582586217e4cf531e718c65032b79152022 or the newer exact
candidate already established in your current records.
Do not revert newer work.

Prove:
upload -> review -> approve -> publish -> permitted download
-> unauthorized denial -> withdraw -> subsequent delivery denied.

Include the required concurrent-update, timestamp-precision,
upload-recovery, orphan-safety and logout/account-switch checks.
Keep all activity inside the authorized staging scope.

B:
Complete the exact-source review and independently verify the
managed results. Coordinate execution with A; no duplicate
heavy runs. Return acceptance or a precise failing case.

FABLE:
Take one actual failing case or assigned non-overlapping task.
Do not spend this window writing another relay or reconciliation
document. Checkpoint useful work before your usage limit.

AFTER PASS:
A finalizes the exact candidate and performs the qualified
deployment and reviewed activation within the standing authority.
Do not replay the installed production migration.

If a specific content, audience, credential, cost or test effect
is outside that authority, name that missing decision once.
Do not request general approval again.

NEXT UPDATE MUST CONTAIN:
- exact source and staging project;
- actual managed checks completed and their results;
- B's verdict;
- deployment/activation result or the first concrete blocker.

A forwarded message is not an execution result.
Preserve required gates, existing data and current running work.

--- Founder context accompanying the directive (verbatim in intent) ---
- Samuel verified tetynodzrtmdbuzgboro directly: status ACTIVE_HEALTHY. The restoration blocker is cleared. Do not restore, reset or recreate it again. He performed a read-only status check only.
- A healthy project does not prove the workflow works; the team can now test it rather than keep relaying instructions.
- Priority has changed from "restore staging" to "prove the workflow, then activate it". Keep optional polish and unrelated features out of this release's critical path while the separate follow-on build continues.
- Older chat uploads have expired; re-upload only a specific original that needs to be reopened and is unavailable in existing local copies.
